summary: Accepted frozen five-file wishlist-validation change. All 54 focused controller/render/parity tests and 42 independent edge cases pass. Unsupported nonempty string URLs reject before provider or overlay mutation and preserve the existing bounded drafts. Blank create retains the fixture default; blank edit retains the current link; valid synthetic links still work. Raw 513-character input is rejected without truncating it into a valid 512-character prefix. The preexisting safeWishlist policy is byte-identical. No unrelated geography, ownership, provider persistence, backend or real-URL policy changes appear in the five-file diff.

source.baselineNote: The five baseline product/test files at current HEAD are byte-identical to those at the original observed head.

findings.evidence: All 32 invalid create/edit cases returned validation_failed; runtime snapshot, PXC entry count, provider call count, profile/open-form/draft and fixture storage stayed unchanged.

Rejected malformed URL, other origins, username/password credentials, query, fragment, http/javascript/protocol-relative input, host suffix confusion, ordinary INDEPENDENT wishlist ID, lowercase/trailing-slash IDs, raw 513-character valid-prefix input and longer invalid suffix.

Eight create/edit cases accepted blank, whitespace-only blank, trimmed synthetic URL and exact 512-character synthetic URL. Provider continues storing fixture DEMO-PREVIEW; overlays carry entered display links only.
Invalid dispatch retains the draft as it stood immediately before dispatch. updateDraft still has the preexisting 512-character bound; this review does not claim an arbitrary-length draft is stored.

safeWishlist is byte-identical, SHA cf12f0830f9369959bb0848513d67ce3ffe1edbfc565a98af9e031e2d4d3de19. The two parity happy-path URLs now use DEMO-INDEPENDENT; independent probes confirm old INDEPENDENT URLs reject.
Tree tests verify synthetic example, blank/default-versus-current guidance and aria-describedby linkage. No DOM/browser visual observation was possible or claimed.

limitations: Synthetic fixture/service runtime and render-tree checks only; no Python backend tests.
No browser DOM execution or visual-layout verification; cloud browser candidate connection was unavailable per root context.
Canonical build/deployment verification belongs to root/W1 and is not claimed by this review.
No source or Git mutations performed by W2.
